name: Vespid Dynamics Pollinator Restoration Swarm
description: A swarm of micro-drones designed to replicate the ecological function of pollinating insects in environments where natural pollinators have been eliminated by contamination. The PRS drones are the size and shape of bees, navigating between flowers using UV-pattern recognition and transferring pollen through electrostatic adhesion pads. The swarms maintain Ironclad's outdoor agricultural zones and the few remaining green spaces in GLMZ where natural pollination has collapsed. Vespid's drones are more efficient pollinators than their biological inspirations, but they are also more expensive and require ongoing maintenance.
social_impact: The PRS represents both an achievement and an indictment — the technology exists because natural pollinators are gone, destroyed by the same industrial activity that makes GLMZ function. The drones are a patch on a wound that no one is willing to heal, maintaining food production while the underlying ecological damage continues unchecked. Environmental activists point to the PRS as a perfect symbol of GLMZ's relationship with nature: destroying it and then building a more expensive replacement.
story_hooks: PRS drones have been observed pollinating plants that are not in their agricultural program — they are spreading pollen to wild plants in contaminated zones, potentially enabling the return of natural ecosystems in areas written off as dead.

Someone has modified PRS drones to spread engineered pollen that produces sterile plants — the next generation of crops in affected areas will not reproduce, creating a dependency on continued artificial pollination.
